input_contract: Only120 train RGB, supplied cameras/times; alpha only black-composites RGB. No known static colors/masks, old weights/hulls, instance/material labels or body count. No val/test images enter discovery/training.
geometry_contract: Dense normalized-patch plane sweep inside a camera-derived global depth range, four fit/two held images, depth uniqueness and independent-source depth/reprojection checks. Missing depth is unknown. No per-point requirement to appear in multiple global time thirds. Stationarity is conditional on observed visibility; learned semantic segmentation is absent.
initialization_contract: Surface voxels from verified dense depths across all visible training times, with no proximity-to-old-anchor constraint. Common coarse initialization in both arms; finer verified reservoir permits evidence-gated new points in birth arm.
topology_contract: Birth requires independent reservoir geometry plus >=4 supported images and residual/low-alpha trigger. It cannot spawn from residual alone. Preserve old Adam rows/counters and initialize new moments to0; pruning keeps original coarse points. Checkpoints include topology IDs, birth ages, pending reservoir, confidence, full Adam/RNG/sampler/history. Native renderer unchanged.
evaluation: Compare previousS1-CT progressive and matched new arms on identical frozen historical masks, and common new held-camera inferred masks. Inspect native fixed86/188, early/middle/late and original200-camera H264 video. Coverage is not recall; no independent dataset geometry/static GT. Manufactured planar scene tests provide independent mechanism GT.
